mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which may potentiate sumatriptan's vasoconstrictive effects and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative antifungal agents if possible; use lowest effective sumatriptan dose.
